name: John Diva & The Rockets of Love: Your Favorite Drug
description: 80s-style glam / hard rock band touring its fourth album
details:
John Diva & The Rockets of Love play arena rock in the style of 80s glam and hard rock with a tongue-in-cheek show. The tour follows their fourth studio album "Your Favorite Drug" (16 Oct 2026), described by the venue as their hardest-hitting so far; the band has played over 400 shows and supported Def Leppard and Europe.

Venue shop: 36 EUR in advance, 40 EUR at the box office. Bensheim is about 30 km from Mannheim and Heidelberg.
bands: John Diva & The Rockets of Love
